why_it_cannot_pass_vacuously.completeness_loop: over PROVENANCE_REQUIRED_KEYS, a fixed 6-tuple literal ['frames_read_in_order', 'frame_identities', 'derivation_code_digest', 'region_masks', 'alignment_tolerance', 'axis_denominators'] — it cannot iterate zero times
why_it_cannot_pass_vacuously.per_frame_loop: over FRAME_IDENTITY_FIELDS, a fixed 4-tuple literal ['path', 'family', 'seed', 'pixel_digest'] — absent AND present-but-None are both refusals, so a null identity cannot satisfy it
why_it_cannot_pass_vacuously.region_loop: over PROVENANCE_REGIONS, a fixed 2-tuple literal ['PLANAR', 'GRAZING'] — the same fixed tuple region_alignment_assertion iterates
why_it_cannot_pass_vacuously.a_missing_key_raises_rather_than_skips: region_idx[region] is a subscript, not a lookup carrying a default; KeyError is caught only to re-raise as ProvenanceIncompleteError. Probe 'region_mask_GRAZING_absent_from_the_index' proves the difference a skipping loop would hide: with GRAZING absent the loop would otherwise have run once and passed
why_it_cannot_pass_vacuously.no_availability_branch: there is no 'if provenance available' test anywhere in the module. _seal_provenance is the FIRST statement of measure_texture_axes and measure_texture_axes has exactly one return statement, which carries _provenance unconditionally
why_it_cannot_pass_vacuously.the_positive_control: a well-formed call returns all three keys, so the refusals above are not an instrument that refuses everything

defect_found_in_this_instrument_by_the_s.what: the first implementation used attribute lookup carrying a default value in three places. That is the A32/1q lookup-with-default shape — the SAME silent-fallback class 3aa exists to close — and the standing source-scan control (test_palette_statistics SourceScanTests / ComposedGateTests) failed the suite on all three.
defect_found_in_this_instrument_by_the_s.disposition: REPAIRED, not baselined: explicit isinstance tests and explicit membership tests replace every one. A fourth firing was the shape written literally inside an explanatory comment, since the control scans source text; the comment was reworded.
